plan_deviations.trigger: The plan's shorthand digest-profile table omitted normative prose and could be read as omitting nested semantic digests, while WP01 was required to make the owning design total and non-self-referential.
plan_deviations.resolution: Follow corrected SUITE AC-G-02: omit only own root/header identity fields for machine artifacts, retain nested digests, and add prose-utf8-v1. No outcome, dependency, milestone, or downstream boundary changed.

plan_deviations.trigger: An exact source digest cannot be embedded in the complete source bytes it identifies without self-reference.
plan_deviations.resolution: SUITE AC-G-02 now makes source_digest detached index provenance while retaining embeddable projection-omitted canonical_digest.

plan_deviations.trigger: serde_yaml_ng 0.10.0 cannot enforce a configurable alias bound before alias materialization, and the EBNF header is metadata rather than grammar payload.
plan_deviations.resolution: The governed YAML subset rejects anchors/aliases/tags/merges in a bounded pre-scan, and ebnf-source-v1 validates then omits its header while retaining exact LF-normalized payload bytes.

plan_deviations.trigger: uv_build packages small runtime resources from the Python module root rather than an arbitrary repository-external contracts/generated path.
plan_deviations.resolution: The one canonical artifact index moved under codefabric_cpg_mcp/contracts so importlib.resources and Rust include_bytes consume the exact same file; all design references and catalog output edges were updated.

plan_deviations.trigger: A full fresh Cargo target rebuild does not measure the accepted Python-only duplicate-test edge and repeatedly surfaced correctness findings rather than decision-relevant timing.
plan_deviations.resolution: Use five-run Hyperfine timing at the unchanged adapter aggregate boundary plus exact pytest-node and 51-atom proof equivalence. Retain fresh-target attempts only as negative correctness evidence and make no cold-build performance claim.

plan_deviations.trigger: The independent WP09 review found that bundle-ac-g-07-v1 still projected a generic JSON value and accepted incomplete or unknown bundle structure despite WP03's closed-model requirement.
plan_deviations.resolution: Define closed AC-G-07 bundle, member, compatibility, and generator records; derive both sorted projections from the typed value; migrate all eight scaffolds; and use serde_path_to_error 0.1.20 at the shared typed ingress seam for exact nested diagnostics. Full member population remains v4 WP11 scope.
